blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every London office has its weekly rhythm. On Monday the team has a planning meeting. On Wednesday there are calls with clients. On Friday people write a short report and finish the week.

English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. When you know the days of the week, you can talk about your week very easily. "On Monday I plan." "On Friday I finish." It is simple and clear.

The Present Simple is for routines — things you do every week. We say "On Monday we have the meeting" and "She works on Wednesday." For he, she and it we add -s: she works, he calls. Knowing the rhythm makes the team predictable, so nobody is surprised.

items.q: What does the team do on Monday?
items.why: "On Monday the team has a planning meeting."

items.q: When do people write a short report?
items.why: "On Friday people write a short report and finish the week."

items.q: The Present Simple is used for…
options: things you will do next year
items.why: "The Present Simple is for routines — things you do every week."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: reports should be written on Monday
the days of the week are hard to learn
a clear weekly rhythm helps the team
items.why: Inferência: "Knowing the rhythm makes the team predictable" — o ritmo claro ajuda o time.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that…
options: English is only for native speakers
English is too difficult to learn
you should focus on what you can do
items.why: Inferência: a frase é um convite otimista — pense no que você CONSEGUE dizer.

blocks.instruction: Ouça um colega descrever sua semana típica no escritório de Londres. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Let me tell you about my week here in the London office. My week is always the same, and I like it that way. It is easy, and I always know what comes next.

On Monday we have the market meeting. It starts at nine, and it is a busy morning. There is a lot of coffee! On Tuesday I usually visit clients, so I am not in the office much. I like Tuesday because I travel and I meet new people. On Wednesday we call the team in Santos at two in the afternoon. They are very nice, and we talk about the market.

Thursday is a big day for me. The weekly report is due, so I write it in the morning and I check the numbers twice. It is a lot of work, but I feel good when it is finished.

On Friday we finish earlier. We have a short meeting, we drink tea, and we talk about the weekend. I love Friday afternoon! Then the weekend starts and I rest. On Saturday and Sunday I do not work. I stay with my family. On Monday the rhythm starts again, and I am ready.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What happens on Monday?
items.why: "On Monday we have the market meeting. It starts at nine."

items.q: What does the speaker usually do on Tuesday?
items.why: "On Tuesday I usually visit clients."

items.q: Why is Thursday a big day?
options: The clients come to the office
items.why: "Thursday is a big day for me. The weekly report is due."

items.q: Why does the speaker check the numbers twice?
options: Because they want the report to be correct
Because they are bored on Thursday
Because the clients ask for it
items.why: Inferência: checar duas vezes mostra cuidado para o relatório sair certo.

items.q: How does the speaker feel about their week?
options: They like the routine and enjoy Friday
They are unhappy with the routine
They want to change every day
They think the week is too short
items.why: Inferência: "My week is always the same, and I like it that way" e "I love Friday afternoon!"

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a big meeting every Monday." A meeting is…
options: a time when people talk about work together
items.why: Meeting = reunião: quando as pessoas se juntam para conversar sobre o trabalho.

items.q: "Please send me your report by Friday." A report is…
items.why: Report = relatório: um documento escrito sobre o trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I do not work on the ___; I rest on Saturday and Sunday."
items.why: Weekend = fim de semana (sábado e domingo).

items.q: Choose the correct day: "The week starts on ___."
items.why: Monday = segunda-feira, o primeiro dia da semana de trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On Friday we finish ___ and start the weekend."
items.why: "On Friday we finish earlier." — na sexta terminamos mais cedo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's wrap up the meeting; it is late." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = encerrar, terminar algo.

items.q: "On Friday we catch up over tea." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, trocar novidades.

items.q: "I take a day off on Saturday." A day off is…
options: a day you do not work
the first day of the week
items.why: Day off = dia de folga, dia em que você não trabalha.

items.q: "Can you fill in this report for me?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, completar com as informações.

items.q: "Let's go over the numbers before Friday." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, dar uma olhada com cuidado.
